profiles.name: XBJ 360 · Allwinner · Android 14
profiles.strengths: Android 14/API 34; stock remote-friendly home screen; casting apps installed.
profiles.limitations: About 1 GB RAM; 32-bit Android app environment; limited internal storage. Factory defaults have not been captured on an untouched unit.
knownIssues: Firmware rewrites accessibility services on focused-app changes. Preserve the original com.oranth.accessibility helper.
User reports excellent horizontal navigation but Up/Down skips posters and selects navigation/buttons. This is a target-selection limitation in the original helper.
350 ms repeat trial was reverted to 150 ms with 400 ms hold timeout after feedback; timing changes are not a fix and are not automatic profile actions.

profiles.name: XBJ B11 · HiSilicon · Android 9
profiles.strengths: Stock Lemon launcher; vendor picture, sound and projection menus were opened and verified on the tested unit.
profiles.limitations: About 1 GB RAM; API 28/Android 9 despite the Settings label. Picture calibration needs visual checking; no measured brightness or speed gain. Factory defaults remain unknown.
